changelog: GlukVPN 1.6.0: Скелетоны на всю ширину, честный раздельный подсчёт трафика и пинга на Windows, ограничения серверов и настройки автоподключения на Android.
_notes: Update manifest for Desktop, Android and the extension. Clients poll this
at start-up and every 4 hours, compare semver against their own version,
and show a banner only when this file is strictly newer.
It deliberately reports the version that is actually published right now,
not the next planned one. Publishing a higher number before the installer
exists would show every user an update banner pointing at a 404, which is
worse than showing nothing at all.
This file is GENERATED by site/deploy/sync-downloads.sh - do not bump the
version by hand. A release is two steps on the server:
1. upload GlukVPN-Setup-X.Y.Z.exe and glukvpn-release-X.Y.Z.apk into
/var/www/vpn.gluk.tech/downloads/ - exactly those two files live there
2. run site/deploy/sync-downloads.sh
The script reads X.Y.Z out of the file names, rewrites version, build,
releaseDate and downloads.* here, regenerates the /download/windows and
/download/android redirects for nginx, and fixes www-data:www-data 644,
so the pages, the redirects and client auto-updates can no longer
disagree about which version is published.
Fields the script keeps instead of inventing: changelog (one line in
Russian, --changelog overrides it) and minSupportedVersion - raise that
only to force an upgrade, since it turns the banner into a blocking
notice, never routinely.
downloads.* stay versioned and site-relative on purpose: clients fetch
them directly, so there is one redirect less to fail inside an
installer, and the same manifest works unchanged on beta and behind any
future mirror. endpoints.* are the permanent links the web pages use.
